children: One employee suffered medium-severity injuries in an explosion at the Czech Colt CZ Group
small-calibre ammunition plant on Wednesday, Czech media reported.
The incident is being investigated as workplace injury, news website www.novinky.cz said. A spokesperson for the company  was not immediately available for comment.
